Name: Farmer Portraits
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod, a portrait for the player can be shown on the left side of dialogue boxes in customizable situations.


[size=5][b]Display Options[/b][/size]

There are three options for deciding when to display the player's portrait:

[list]
[*][b]ShowWithQuestions [/b]- show with question dialogue boxes
[*][b]ShowWithEvents [/b]- show during events
[*][b]ShowWithNPCPortrait [/b]- show when an NPC's portrait is shown
[/list]

[size=5][b]Portrait Options[/b][/size]

By default, the mod uses the in-game farmer sprite scaled up 4x, facing right. The portrait is animated, blinking and showing clothing and accessory animations as well.

You can choose in the config to change it to front facing, and you can opt to use a custom static image for the portrait and background as well.

To use a custom portrait and background, make sure config variable [b]UseCustomPortrait[/b] is [b]true[/b], then either place png files in the mod's folder or use a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] pack.


[size=5][b]Mod Folder[/b][/size]

For custom portrait and/or background in the mod folder, place the following files in this mod's folder:

[b]portrait.png[/b]

[b]background.png[/b]


[size=5][b]Content Patcher[/b][/size]

Target the following paths in you content pack:

[b]aedenthorn.FarmerPortraits/portrait

aedenthorn.FarmerPortraits/background[/b]

There is an example pack in the files section you can use as a template. You can install it and simply replace its PNG files with your own.


[b][size=5]Farmer-Specific[/size][/b]

You can use per-farmer portraits using an underscore "_" followed by the farmer name, e.g.:

[b]portrait_Erin.png[/b] 

or

[b][b]aedenthorn.FarmerPortraits/portrait[b]_Erin[/b][/b][/b]


[b][size=5]Emotions[/size][/b]

You can use portraits that reflect NPC emotions using numbers starting from 0, e.g.:

[b]portrait0.png[/b] 

or

[b][b]aedenthorn.FarmerPortraits/portrait0[/b][/b]

for neutral emotion.

See [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Dialogue#Portrait_commands]here[/url] for what each number means.


[b][size=5]Console[/size][/b]

You can add a portrait or background using the SMAPI console, as follows:
[list=1]

[*]type one of the following commands into the SMAPI console:

[list]
[*][b]fppg[/b] - global portrait
[*][b]fppme[/b] - portrait for this farmer
[*][b]fpbg[/b] - global background
[*][b]fpbme[/b] - background for this farmer
[/list]
[*]add a space after the above command.
[*]drag and drop a png file of the right size onto the SMAPI console.
[/list]
For example:

[b]fppg C:\MyPortraitsFolder\myportraitsfile123.png[/b]

This will copy the above file to a file called [b]portrait.png[/b] in this mod's folder, and reload the cached textures.


[b][size=5]Notes[/size][/b]

Names and emotions can be combined, e.g.:

[b]portrait0_Erin.png[/b]

Portraits and backgrounds can be hi-res or lo-res, as preferred.

Thanks to Asterisk for the custom portrait used in the last screenshot!


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
